title: SQL Server 2022 Testcontainer exits with code 1 via handle-crash.sh, breaking EF Core/SqlClient tests
error_pattern:
Class fixture type 'Aspire.Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.Tests.SqlServerContainerFixture' threw in InitializeAsync
---- DotNet.Testcontainers.Containers.ContainerNotRunningException : Container ... exited with code 1.
  Stdout:
    SQL Server 2022 will run as non-root by default.
    This container is running as user mssql.
    Executing: /opt/mssql/bin/handle-crash.sh with parameters
         handle-crash.sh
         /opt/mssql/bin/sqlservr
analysis: All 36 tests in EnrichSqlServerTests failed identically because the shared xUnit class fixture (SqlServerContainerFixture) could not start the SQL Server 2022 Docker container — it exited with code 1 and invoked /opt/mssql/bin/handle-crash.sh shortly after startup. This is an infrastructure/container-runtime crash distinct from the previously tracked exit-code-255 CoInitializeSecurity failure and from port-conflict/Ryuk-registry causes. The PR under test only modifies GitHub Actions workflow YAML files and adds a workflow-script test (tests/Infrastructure.Tests/WorkflowScripts/AgenticWorkflowTests.cs); it does not touch SQL Server, EF Core, or SqlClient related source or test code, so the failure cannot be attributed to the PR.
